title: Audience-tailored launch summaries and signoff playbook
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Summary: Create a lightweight, repeatable playbook and deliverables bundle for drafting release notes and coordinating signoff across teams, with explicit audience tailoring (exec, developer, end-customer), an embargo/redaction matrix, and localization handoff.

Goals:
- Deliver three synchronized artifacts per launch: Exec brief (one-pager), Customer-facing changelog (public), and Developer changelog (technical details and upgrade notes).
- Define an explicit review matrix with SLAs for reviewers (Eng: 48h, Design: 72h, Legal: 72h, Support: 24h).
- Put in place a lightweight redaction matrix to safely surface feature context without leaking contract/enterprise-only signals.
- Provide a localization handoff and translation timeline to support EMEA/APAC launches.

Scope: Applies to hosted API, Dedicated, and Private releases where customer-visible behavior changes (API surface, pricing signal, or documented config changes) are present. Routine bugfix releases with no customer-visible effect follow the fast-path template in the playbook.

Deliverables (for each launch):
1) Exec brief: 1 page, impact, metrics to watch, rollback triggers.
2) Customer-facing changelog: Tiered sections (Highlights, What changed, How it affects you, Migration steps if any, Known issues).
3) Developer changelog: Model/version mapping, breaking changes, config flags, sample cURL/SDK snippets.
4) Internal review tracker (single Google Sheet row per release) + signoff checklist.
5) Localization packet: text strings + context + glossary.

Redaction rules (working draft):
- Showable to public: feature headline, non-sensitive behavioral change, guidance.
- Internal-only: deployment schedules tied to customer accounts, reserved capacity allocations, internal SLA numbers.
- Enterprise-only (visible to enterprise customers in their portal/email): contract-specific pricing, migration windows.

Review flow and owner matrix:
- Draft owner: PM (owner creates first draft using template).
- Engineering reviewer: ENG lead (API/behavior accuracy, integration notes).
- Design reviewer: Design lead (clarity and screenshots).
- Legal reviewer: Legal (redaction check for contractual language).
- Customer support reviewer: Support lead (troubleshooting guidance, external KB links).
- Final signoff: PM + GTM lead.

Publishing cadence and channels:
- Public changelog (Website) -> publish after final signoff and embargo lift.
- Email digest for customers segmented by tier (Enterprise / Developer / Trial).
- Internal slack announcement (#prod-launches) with pinned docs and support playbook link.

Localization / translation notes:
- Two-week minimum for non-critical text. For critical launches, prioritize English + EU locales; use machine-assisted translation + human review.

Acceptance criteria (see separate field below) and rollbacks: each release must list rollback triggers (latency increase, defect rate, customer-reported regressions) and an on-call escalation path.

Notes: This ticket frames the playbook and will include templates in Confluence and a starter Google Doc that PMs can copy. The playbook emphasizes speed while minimizing legal/regulatory risk via the redaction matrix.
acceptance_criteria: Three templates (Exec brief, Customer changelog, Developer changelog) added to Confluence with examples
Review matrix documented with named reviewers and SLAs
Redaction matrix added and approved by Legal
Localization handoff template published and translation timeline documented
Pilot used for next minor release and signoff completed within target SLAs
